articles.title: OPPO, Nidec have taken Qi Wireless Power patent pool license, Via announces during AI licensing-focused Summit
articles.description: During its annual Bridge Summit in San Francisco today, which will largely focus on opportunities and strategies in AI patent licensing, Via Licensing Alliance announced Japan’s Nidec Mobility Corporation and China’s OPPO – already a licensor – have both taken a license in Via's Qi Wireless Power patent pool.
